name: OpenUI
summary: Generative UI framework and language: models stream compact UI code that React, Vue, Svelte and Angular runtimes render progressively.
description: OpenUI Lang is a compact, streaming-first language for model-generated UI — up to 67% fewer tokens than JSON. A framework-agnostic core powers first-party runtimes for React, Vue, Svelte and Angular; the React packages add headless chat state, prebuilt chat layouts and two built-in component libraries (charts, forms, tables). Generate a prompt from the components you allow, stream the model output and render it progressively. Also LangChain/assistant-ui integrations, an email renderer, browser bundle, A2UI client, CLI and an agent skill for Claude Code and Cursor.
